summary: Ziosk brands itself "the pioneer of pay-at-the-table technology," offering a guest-facing tabletop tablet (Ziosk Mini), a server handheld (Ziosk Pro), a contactless digital check presenter ("Drop & Pay"), and add-on guest engagement games; it integrates with POS systems including Aloha, Oracle Micros, and Positouch, and payment processors including Fiserv, Worldpay, Chase, and FreedomPay, without requiring a POS replacement.
Ziosk names Chili's, Texas Roadhouse, Olive Garden, Red Robin, Outback Steakhouse, and Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen among its restaurant clients.

Ziosk claims a 90% pay-at-table adoption rate, 18% faster table turns, a 20% boost in server tips, and engages 1 billion guests annually across its client base. (Scope note: Vendor-reported aggregate performance statistics blended across Ziosk's full client base, not tied to any single named operator or independently audited.)
